COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Aug-01-2005 Vacated
MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Settlement on the record.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Bryon Thomas, Esq. for Plaintiff: Fellowship Manor, present by: Kim Abram, manager.
MaryAnn Mini, Esq. for Defendant: Lauren Brooks, also present.
Matter settled, terms read into the record as follows: Parties stipulated for an ENTRY of JUDGMENT for resitution and possession, or Dimissal upon vacate.
Plaintiff waives back rent, damages, fees and costs if Defendant vacate the premises located at 1201 Golden Gate Ave., #319, San Francisco on or before 11:59 P.M. of 10-01-05, return keys to the office or drop-box in the building, and no excessive traffic to the property.
If Defendant failed, upon 72 hrs ex parte notice to defendant's counsel for Evidentiary Hearing and for Judgment for back-rents, damages, fees and costs.
Mr. Thomas will reduced to writting and for Ms. Mini to prove-read, before submit to the court for signature.
Parties agreed to terms, matter is deemed settled, Trial vacated.
Counsel to prepare Stipulation for Entry of Judgment.
